about_the_game:
OVERVIEW

Pursuit of Life is a cozy–yet–ambitious 2D pixel-art life sim set in a sunny beach city. Start in your parents’ spare room and leap straight into the hustle. Shape a unique future through the jobs you work, skills you master, businesses you launch, and relationships you grow—all inside an open sandbox that remembers every choice you make.

KEY FEATURES

  • Open-ended sandbox – Set your own goals, pursue them at your pace, and watch the city react to every decision.

  • Zero-grind mini-games – Snappy loops for cooking, gardening, gigs, and side hustles keep downtime light and rewarding.

  • Extensive customization – Mix-and-match hair, outfits, body types, and skin tones for both your character and NPCs.

  • Four vibrant biomes – Explore cozy suburbs, a bustling downtown, sun-soaked beaches, and tranquil mountain trails, each with unique jobs, events, and secrets.

  • Fame & reputation system – Compete, perform, or create to gain fame; celebrity status unlocks VIP events and exclusive perks.

  • Branching social quests – Meaningful choices steer friendships, rivalries, and romance, influencing storylines and opportunities.

  • Deep progression loops – Level careers, hobbies, and personal stats to unlock new abilities, story arcs, and rare items.

  • Career ladder to CEO – Start as a retail sales associate, climb the ladder, and ultimately run the company.

  • System-driven economy – Rent, buy, invest, and operate storefronts in a living marketplace shaped by supply and demand.

  • Accessibility first – Full controller support, remappable inputs, and UI scaling options.

Chart your own course, build lasting connections, and watch the city evolve around you. Add Pursuit of Life to your wishlist and begin crafting the life you’ve always imagined!
